en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural valley scene with a densely wooded hillside in the background and several detached villas and houses along a curved road in the foreground. The printed caption in red Gothic-style script at the top identifies the place as Kötzschenbroda and mentions a view from the Lössnitz valley (Lössnitz-Grunde). Additional red vertical text is printed along the right edge, likely indicating the publisher from Kötzschenbroda.
